name: Mongoose Miles
tagline: GPS and telematics for people with too many vehicles and not enough answers.
positioning: Fleet-grade tracking, trip logs, and maintenance nagging for individuals and side-hustlers who aren't a Fortune 500 logistics department.

hero.h1: Know where your stuff went. And who was driving it.
hero.sub: Mongoose Miles plugs into your truck, van, boat trailer, or that project car and tells you where it is, how it's being treated, and when it needs oil — without a dispatcher or a 30-page quote.

features.title: Where'd it go
features.description: Live location on every vehicle, refreshed every few seconds. Draw a geofence around home and get pinged the second something rolls out at 2am.

features.title: Trip logs that survive an audit
features.description: Every drive auto-sorted into business or personal, with mileage totals your accountant will actually accept at tax time.

features.title: Maintenance nagging
features.description: Odometer-based reminders for oil, tires, and registration so you stop discovering problems on the shoulder of the interstate.

features.title: Driver report cards
features.description: Hard braking, speeding, and idle time scored per driver. Great for teenagers, contractors, and your own denial.

features.title: Tamper alerts
features.description: Battery unplugged? Device yanked? Vehicle towed while you slept? You'll know before the tow lot does.

features.title: Works with your junk
features.description: OBD-II plug, hardwire, or magnetic asset tracker for trailers and equipment. One app, no fleet-manager login cosplay.

testimonials.quote: I run three landscaping trucks out of my driveway. Mongoose caught a guy 'working late' at a bar 40 miles off route. The subscription pays for itself in awkward conversations.
testimonials.name: Dwayne Ferro

testimonials.quote: Two boats, a trailer, and a truck that my brother-in-law borrows. Now I get a text the moment any of it leaves the property. He's stopped asking.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

testimonials.quote: The mileage log alone got me a clean deduction. My old system was a shoebox of gas receipts and vibes. This is better than vibes.
testimonials.name: Cole Aberdeen

pricing.blurb: One vehicle, all the tracking, none of the spreadsheets.
For the driveway that's slowly becoming a depot.
features: Shared access for family or crew

pricing.blurb: Trucks, trailers, boats, and heavy equipment on one map.

homepage.footerBlurb: Mongoose Miles: fleet-grade telematics scaled down to human-sized problems. Built for the people who own the vehicles, not a department.
